name: Stripe
description: Stripe offers online payment infrastructure, fraud prevention, and APIs enabling businesses to accept and manage payments globally

tools.name: Accept quote
tools.description: Tool to accept a quote in Stripe. Use when you need to accept a finalized quote, which will create an invoice, subscription, or subscription schedule based on the quote's configuration.

inputs.name: quote_id
inputs.about: The ID of the quote to accept. Must start with 'qt_'.

tools.name: Activate billing alert
tools.description: Reactivates a billing alert, allowing it to trigger again. Use when you need to resume monitoring usage thresholds and receiving notifications for a previously deactivated alert.

inputs.name: alert_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the billing alert to reactivate (e.g., 'alrt_12345').

tools.name: Add lines to invoice
tools.description: Tool to add multiple line items to a draft Stripe invoice. Use when you need to add additional charges, services, or credits to an existing invoice that is still in draft status.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID of the invoice to add lines to. Invoice must be in draft status.

inputs.name: lines
inputs.about: Multiple line items to attach to the invoice. At least one line item is required.

inputs.name: invoice_metadata
inputs.about: Set of key-value pairs to attach to the invoice itself.

tools.name: Advance test clock
tools.description: Advance a test clock to a future timestamp. Use for testing time-based billing scenarios. Requires test mode API keys (test_helpers endpoints are only available in test mode). The advancement is asynchronous; monitor the status field to track completion (status changes from 'advancing' to 'ready').

inputs.name: clock_id
inputs.about: The ID of the test clock to advance (format: clock_*). Obtain this from creating a test clock or listing existing test clocks.

inputs.name: frozen_time
inputs.about: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) to advance the clock to. Must be greater than the clock's current frozen_time. Maximum advance: 2 subscription intervals ahead, or 2 years if no subscriptions.

tools.name: Apply customer balance to payment intent
tools.description: Manually reconciles remaining amount for a customer_balance PaymentIntent by applying funds from customer's cash balance. IMPORTANT: This action only works with PaymentIntents that have 'customer_balance' in their payment_method_types. The customer_balance payment method type must be enabled in your Stripe account settings. Use this when you need to apply funds from a customer's cash balance account to complete or partially fund a PaymentIntent.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.about: Amount intended to apply to this PaymentIntent from the customer's cash balance. A positive integer representing how much to charge in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00 USD, or 100 to charge ¥100 JPY for zero-decimal currencies). The maximum amount is the amount of the Paym

inputs.name: intent
inputs.about: The PaymentIntent identifier. Must be a PaymentIntent that uses 'customer_balance' as a payment method type.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.about: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase. Must be a supported currency.

tools.name: Archive billing alert
tools.description: Tool to archive a billing alert in Stripe, removing it from list views and APIs. Use when you need to permanently archive a billing alert. This action is non-reversible.

inputs.name: alert_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the billing alert to archive.

tools.name: Attach source to customer
tools.description: Attach a payment source (card token or source object) to a customer for future charges. IMPORTANT: This is a legacy API. For new integrations, use the PaymentMethods API instead (STRIPE_ATTACH_PAYMENT_METHOD). The source parameter accepts: - Card tokens (tok_xxxx) created client-side via Stripe.js or mobile SDKs - Source objects (src_xxxx) for alternative payment methods NOTE: PaymentMethod objects (pm_xxxx) cannot be used with this endpoint. Use STRIPE_ATTACH_PAYMENT_METHOD for those. In test mode, you can use test tokens like 'tok_visa'. In live mode, tokens must be created client-side for PCI compliance.

inputs.name: source
inputs.about: The source to attach. Can be a card token ID (tok_xxx) or source object ID (src_xxx). In test mode, you can use 'tok_visa' or 'tok_mastercard'. In live mode, tokens must be created client-side using Stripe.js, Elements, or mobile SDKs. Note: Cannot use PaymentMethod IDs (pm_xxx) - use STRIPE_ATTACH_

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.

inputs.name: customer_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Stripe customer to attach the source to.

tools.name: Attach payment to invoice
tools.description: Attaches a PaymentIntent or Out of Band Payment to an invoice's payments list. When the PaymentIntent status changes to succeeded, the payment is credited to the invoice. Use when you need to associate an existing payment with a specific invoice.

inputs.name: invoice
inputs.about: The ID of the invoice to attach the payment to.

inputs.name: payment_intent
inputs.about: The ID of the PaymentIntent to attach to the invoice. Must be a PaymentIntent that can be attached to the invoice. Either payment_intent or payment_record must be provided, but not both.

inputs.name: payment_record
inputs.about: The ID of the PaymentRecord to attach to the invoice. This is used for Out of Band payments. Either payment_intent or payment_record must be provided, but not both.

tools.name: Attach payment method to customer
tools.description: Attaches a PaymentMethod to a Customer. Use when you need to save a payment method for future use with a specific customer. The PaymentMethod must be in a detached state before attaching.

inputs.name: customer
inputs.about: The ID of the customer to which to attach the PaymentMethod. Either customer or customer_account must be provided.

inputs.name: customer_account
inputs.about: The ID of the Account representing the customer to which to attach the PaymentMethod. Either customer or customer_account must be provided.

inputs.name: payment_method_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the PaymentMethod to attach to the customer. The PaymentMethod must be in a detached state.

tools.name: Attach feature to product
tools.description: Tool to attach a feature to a product. Use when you need to add a feature to a product's capabilities. This creates a product_feature object linking the feature to the product.

inputs.name: product_id
inputs.about: The ID of the product to attach the feature to. Product IDs typically start with 'prod_'.

inputs.name: entitlement_feature
inputs.about: The ID of the Feature object to attach to this product. Feature IDs typically start with 'feat_'.

tools.name: Cancel payment intent
tools.description: Cancels a PaymentIntent when in cancelable state. Use when a PaymentIntent is no longer needed to prevent further charges. For PaymentIntents with status='requires_capture', the remaining amount_capturable will be automatically refunded.

inputs.name: payment_intent_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the PaymentIntent to cancel.

inputs.name: cancellation_reason
inputs.about: Reason for canceling this PaymentIntent. Must be one of: 'duplicate', 'fraudulent', 'requested_by_customer', or 'abandoned'.

tools.name: Cancel Quote
tools.description: Tool to cancel a Stripe quote. Use when you need to cancel an existing quote that is in 'draft' or 'open' status. Once canceled, the quote cannot be finalized or accepted by the customer.

inputs.name: quote_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the quote to cancel. Starts with 'qt_'.

tools.name: Cancel setup intent
tools.description: Cancels a SetupIntent that is no longer needed. Use when a SetupIntent is in 'requires_payment_method', 'requires_confirmation', or 'requires_action' state. Note: SetupIntents linked to Checkout Sessions cannot be canceled through this method.

inputs.name: setup_intent_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the SetupIntent to cancel.

inputs.name: cancellation_reason
inputs.about: Reason for cancellation. Must be one of: 'abandoned', 'requested_by_customer', or 'duplicate'.

tools.name: Cancel subscription
tools.description: Cancels a customer's Stripe subscription immediately, with options to invoice for metered usage and prorate charges for unused time.

inputs.name: prorate
inputs.about: If true, generates a proration invoice item for unused time remaining in the current billing cycle.

inputs.name: invoice_now
inputs.about: If true, generates a final invoice for any un-invoiced metered usage.

inputs.name: subscription_id
inputs.about: Identifier of the subscription to cancel.

inputs.name: cancellation_details
inputs.about: Specifies reasons for cancellation. Common keys: 'comment' (free-form text) and 'feedback' (e.g., 'customer_service', 'low_usage', 'switched_service'). Example: {'comment': 'Switching services.', 'feedback': 'switched_service'}

tools.name: Cancel subscription schedule
tools.description: Cancels a subscription schedule and its associated subscription immediately if active. Only schedules with status 'not_started' or 'active' can be canceled.

inputs.name: prorate
inputs.about: If the subscription schedule is 'active', indicates if the cancellation should be prorated. Defaults to true if not specified.

inputs.name: schedule
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the subscription schedule to cancel (e.g., sub_sched_1Mr3owLkdIwHu7ix38CXMudt)

inputs.name: invoice_now
inputs.about: If the subscription schedule is 'active', indicates if a final invoice will be generated that contains any un-invoiced metered usage and new/pending proration invoice items. Defaults to true if not specified.

tools.name: Cancel Terminal Reader Action
tools.description: Tool to cancel the current reader action. Use when you need to halt any ongoing operation on a Stripe Terminal reader device such as payment collection, setup intent processing, or input collection.

inputs.name: reader_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Reader to cancel the action on. Must start with 'tmr_' followed by alphanumeric characters.

tools.name: Capture Charge
tools.description: Tool to capture payment on an uncaptured charge. Use when a charge was created with capture=false and you're ready to capture the payment.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.about: The amount to capture in cents (or smallest currency unit). If not specified, the full amount is captured. Cannot exceed the original, uncaptured amount of the charge.

inputs.name: charge
inputs.about: The identifier of the charge to be captured. Typically starts with 'ch_'.

inputs.name: receipt_email
inputs.about: The email address to send the receipt to. Overrides the charge's receipt_email. Maximum 800 characters. Receipts are not sent in test mode.

inputs.name: transfer_group
inputs.about: Transaction group identifier. May only be provided if not previously set.

inputs.name: statement_descriptor
inputs.about: Statement descriptor text for non-card charges with 22-character limit. For card charges, ignored if statement_descriptor_suffix is provided.

inputs.name: transfer_data_amount
inputs.about: The amount to transfer to the destination account without creating an Application Fee object. Must be used with Stripe Connect.

inputs.name: application_fee_amount
inputs.about: An application fee amount to add to this charge, not exceeding the original amount.

inputs.name: statement_descriptor_suffix
inputs.about: Suffix concatenated to account's statement descriptor prefix for card charges.

tools.name: Capture payment intent
tools.description: Captures the funds of an existing uncaptured PaymentIntent. Use when the PaymentIntent status is 'requires_capture'.

inputs.name: intent
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the PaymentIntent to capture.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured data. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value.

inputs.name: final_capture
inputs.about: Defaults to true. Set to false to retain uncaptured funds for future captures (requires multicapture support).

inputs.name: amount_to_capture
inputs.about: Amount to capture in smallest currency unit. Must be less than or equal to the original amount. Defaults to full amount_capturable if not provided.

inputs.name: statement_descriptor
inputs.about: Custom statement descriptor for non-card charges. Maximum 22 characters.

inputs.name: application_fee_amount
inputs.about: Application fee to be transferred to the app owner's Stripe account. Cannot exceed the captured amount.

inputs.name: statement_descriptor_suffix
inputs.about: Suffix appended to the account's statement descriptor prefix for card charges. Maximum 22 characters.

tools.name: Close Dispute
tools.description: Tool to close a dispute. Use when you want to dismiss a dispute and acknowledge it as lost, indicating no evidence will be submitted. This action is irreversible.

inputs.name: dispute
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the dispute to close. Typically starts with 'du_'.

tools.name: Set Terminal Reader Display
tools.description: Initiates input collection on a Terminal Reader to display forms and collect customer information. Use when you need to gather email, phone, text, numeric, signature, or selection inputs from customers on a physical reader.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.about: List of inputs to collect from the customer. Maximum 5 inputs per request.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured information about this input collection.

inputs.name: reader_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the terminal reader.

tools.name: Collect payment method on Terminal Reader
tools.description: Tool to initiate payment method collection on a Stripe Terminal Reader. Use when you need to hand off a PaymentIntent to a physical card reader device to collect payment details. The Reader action executes asynchronously with action.status showing 'in_progress' initially.

inputs.name: reader
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Reader device.

inputs.name: collect_config
inputs.about: Configuration overrides for payment collection behavior.

inputs.name: payment_intent
inputs.about: The ID of the PaymentIntent to collect a payment method for.

tools.name: Confirm payment intent
tools.description: Tool to confirm customer intent to pay with current or provided payment method. Use when ready to finalize a PaymentIntent and initiate the payment attempt. A return_url is required if confirmation needs customer action like 3D Secure authentication.

inputs.name: mandate
inputs.about: ID of the mandate to use for this payment.

inputs.name: shipping
inputs.about: Shipping information for this PaymentIntent.

inputs.name: return_url
inputs.about: The URL to redirect your customer back to after they authenticate or cancel their payment. Required if confirmation requires customer action (e.g., 3D Secure).

inputs.name: off_session
inputs.about: Set to true to indicate customer is not in checkout flow, or use 'one_off' or 'recurring' for specific off-session types.

inputs.name: capture_method
inputs.about: Controls fund capture timing. Can be 'automatic', 'automatic_async' (default), or 'manual'.

inputs.name: payment_method
inputs.about: ID of the PaymentMethod to attach to this PaymentIntent.

inputs.name: use_stripe_sdk
inputs.about: Set to true when confirming client-side with Stripe.js or mobile SDKs.

inputs.name: payment_intent_id
inputs.about: The ID of the PaymentIntent to confirm.

inputs.name: confirmation_token
inputs.about: ID of the ConfirmationToken to use for confirmation.

inputs.name: setup_future_usage
inputs.about: Indicates intent to reuse payment method. Use 'on_session' if customer is present, 'off_session' for future charges.

inputs.name: payment_method_data
inputs.about: Hash to create new PaymentMethod with type-specific details. Must include 'type' field (e.g., 'card', 'acss_debit', etc.).

inputs.name: payment_method_options
inputs.about: Payment method-specific configuration (e.g., card installments, 3D Secure, BNPL options).

inputs.name: error_on_requires_action
inputs.about: When true, fails payment if PaymentIntent transitions to 'requires_action'. Default is false.

tools.name: Confirm setup intent
tools.description: Confirms a SetupIntent to complete customer payment method setup. Use when you need to finalize credential collection after creating a SetupIntent.

inputs.name: return_url
inputs.about: URL to redirect customer after authentication. Required for redirect-based payment methods.

inputs.name: payment_method
inputs.about: ID of the PaymentMethod to attach to this SetupIntent.

inputs.name: use_stripe_sdk
inputs.about: Set to true when confirming server-side with Stripe.js or mobile SDKs.

inputs.name: setup_intent_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the SetupIntent to confirm.

inputs.name: confirmation_token
inputs.about: ID of the ConfirmationToken used to confirm this SetupIntent.

tools.name: Confirm PaymentIntent on Terminal Reader
tools.description: Tool to confirm a PaymentIntent on a Terminal reader device. Use when you need to finalize a payment transaction on a card reader after the PaymentIntent has been collected on the reader hardware.

inputs.name: reader_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Terminal reader. Must start with 'tmr_' followed by alphanumeric characters.

inputs.name: confirm_config
inputs.about: Optional configuration for confirming the payment intent.

inputs.name: payment_intent
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the PaymentIntent to be finalized on the reader.

tools.name: Create Card Payments Capability
tools.description: Updates the card payments capability for a Stripe Connect account, requesting or removing the capability. The response includes its status and requirements.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The account ID for which to enable card_payments capability. Typically starts with 'acct_'.

inputs.name: requested
inputs.about: To request the card_payments capability for an account, pass true. Pass false to remove this non-permanent capability that was previously requested.

tools.name: Create Account Session
tools.description: Creates an Account Session for a Stripe Connect account, granting access to embedded components. Use when you need to provide temporary, client-side access to a connected account's dashboard features such as account management, onboarding, payments, and payouts. The Account Session expires relatively quickly and cannot be used more than once. We recommend creating a new Account Session each time you need to display an embedded component to your user.

inputs.name: expand
inputs.about: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.

inputs.name: account
inputs.about: The identifier of the account to create an Account Session for. Starts with 'acct_'.

inputs.name: components
inputs.about: Configuration for embedded components. Each key represents a component, and each value contains the component configuration (e.g., enabled status).

tools.name: Create Apple Pay Domain
tools.description: Tool to create an Apple Pay domain registration. Use when registering your domain with Apple Pay to accept Apple Pay payments on your website. Stripe handles the Apple merchant validation process.

inputs.name: expand
inputs.about: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.

inputs.name: domain_name
inputs.about: The domain name to register for Apple Pay (e.g., 'example.com'). Must be a valid domain. Both top-level domains and subdomains need to be registered separately. Note that www is considered a subdomain.

tools.name: Create apps secret
tools.description: Tool to create a secret in the Stripe Secret Store. Use when you need to securely persist secrets for use by UI Extensions and app backends.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: A name for the secret that's unique within the scope. This describes the secret's identifier within your application.

inputs.name: payload
inputs.about: The plaintext secret value to be encrypted and stored. The encrypted secret value that gets stored securely.

inputs.name: expires_at
inputs.about: Unix timestamp indicating when the secret should expire and become inaccessible. Enables automatic secret expiration for enhanced security.

inputs.name: scope_type
inputs.about: The scope type - either 'account' (makes secrets accessible to all dashboard users and app backends) or 'user' (restricts access to one specific dashboard user plus the app backend).

inputs.name: scope_user
inputs.about: User ID - required when scope_type is 'user', omitted for 'account' type. The user whose secret to create.

tools.name: Create Bank Account Token
tools.description: Tool to create a single-use token representing bank account details. Use when you need to securely collect bank account information for ACH payments, direct debits, or adding a bank account to a customer or recipient.

inputs.name: customer
inputs.about: Create a token for the customer, which is owned by the application's account. Can only be used with an OAuth access token or Stripe-Account header.

inputs.name: bank_account
inputs.about: The bank account this token will represent.

tools.name: Create billing alert
tools.description: Tool to create a billing alert that monitors usage on a billing meter and triggers notifications when a specified threshold is crossed. Use when you need to set up usage-based billing alerts.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The title/name of the alert. Maximum 256 characters.

inputs.name: alert_type
inputs.about: The type of alert to create. Currently only 'usage_threshold' is supported.

inputs.name: usage_threshold
inputs.about: Configuration for usage threshold alerts that monitors a billing meter and triggers when the threshold is crossed.

tools.name: Create billing credit grant
tools.description: Tool to create a credit grant that allocates billing credits to a customer for use against metered pricing. Use when you need to provide promotional or paid credits to customers.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Descriptive name for the credit grant displayed in the dashboard (max 100 characters).

inputs.name: amount
inputs.about: Container for the credit grant amount configuration.

inputs.name: category
inputs.about: Classification of the credit grant. Use 'paid' for customer-purchased credits or 'promotional' for complimentary credits. Defaults to 'paid'.

inputs.name: customer
inputs.about: Customer ID receiving the credits. Must provide either customer or customer_account.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Key-value pairs for storing additional structured data about the credit grant.

inputs.name: priority
inputs.about: Application priority (0=highest, 100=lowest). Controls the order in which credits are applied. Defaults to 50.

inputs.name: expires_at
inputs.about: Unix timestamp when credits expire. Credits never expire if omitted.

inputs.name: effective_at
inputs.about: Unix timestamp when credits become usable. Defaults to current time if not specified.

inputs.name: customer_account
inputs.about: Account ID representing the customer. Must provide either customer or customer_account.

inputs.name: applicability_config
inputs.about: Defines what the credit grant applies to (metered pricing, specific prices, or billable items).

tools.name: Create billing meter
tools.description: Tool to create a billing meter in Stripe for tracking usage events. Use when you need to set up a new meter to track API calls, storage usage, or other measurable customer actions that form the basis of billing calculations.

inputs.name: event_name
inputs.about: The name of the meter event to track (max 100 characters). This should match the event name you'll use when reporting usage events to Stripe.

inputs.name: display_name
inputs.about: The human-readable name for this billing meter (max 250 characters). This name is for internal use and is not visible to customers.

inputs.name: value_settings
inputs.about: Configuration for extracting numeric values from meter events.

inputs.name: customer_mapping
inputs.about: Maps meter events to specific customer accounts.

inputs.name: event_time_window
inputs.about: Pre-aggregation time window for events. Use 'hour' or 'day' if your events are pre-aggregated at those intervals. Leave as None for real-time event tracking.

inputs.name: default_aggregation
inputs.about: Defines how meter events are aggregated over a billing period. Required to specify the aggregation formula.

tools.name: Create Billing Meter Event V2
tools.description: Creates a billing meter event using Stripe API v2 for usage-based billing. Use when recording customer usage that will be metered and billed according to configured billing meters.

inputs.name: payload
inputs.about: The payload of the event containing fields corresponding to a meter's customer mapping. Must include stripe_customer_id and value fields that align with the meter's configuration.

inputs.name: timestamp
inputs.about: The time of the event in ISO 8601 format. Must be within the past 35 calendar days or up to 5 minutes in the future. Defaults to the current time if not specified.

inputs.name: event_name
inputs.about: The name of the meter event that corresponds with the meter. Must match the event_name configured on your billing meter. Maximum length is 100 characters.

inputs.name: identifier
inputs.about: A unique identifier for the event used for deduplication. If not provided, one is auto-generated. We recommend using UUID-like identifiers. Uniqueness is enforced within a rolling 24-hour period. Maximum length is 100 characters.

tools.name: Create Billing Meter Event Adjustment
tools.description: Creates an adjustment to cancel a billing meter event. Use when you need to correct errors or remove events attached to the wrong customer within 24 hours of Stripe receiving them.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Specifies whether to cancel a single event or a range of events. Currently only 'cancel' is supported.

inputs.name: cancel
inputs.about: Specifies which event to cancel.

inputs.name: event_name
inputs.about: The name of the meter event. Corresponds with the event_name field on a meter. Maximum 100 characters.

tools.name: Create Billing Meter Event Session
tools.description: Creates authentication session for high-throughput meter event stream. Use when you need to send meter events to Stripe's billing system; tokens are valid for 15 minutes.

tools.name: Create Billing Portal Configuration
tools.description: Tool to create a Stripe billing portal configuration. Use when you need to define the functionality and behavior of a customer portal session, including which features customers can access.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: A descriptive name for the configuration, displayed in the Stripe Dashboard (max 256 characters).

inputs.name: features
inputs.about: Information about the features available in the portal.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.

inputs.name: login_page
inputs.about: The hosted login page for this configuration. If enabled, a shareable URL will be generated.

inputs.name: business_profile
inputs.about: The business information shown to customers in the portal.

inputs.name: default_return_url
inputs.about: The default URL to redirect customers to when they click on the portal's link to return to your website. This can be overridden when creating a portal session.

tools.name: Create Billing Portal Session
tools.description: Tool to create a Stripe billing portal session. Use when you need to provide customers with a secure URL to manage their subscriptions, payment methods, and invoices.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.about: The IETF language tag of the locale to display the customer portal in. If blank or 'auto', the customer's preferred_locales or browser locale is used.

inputs.name: customer
inputs.about: The ID of an existing customer. One of 'customer' or 'customer_account' is required.

inputs.name: flow_data
inputs.about: Configuration for guided customer flows in the portal.

inputs.name: return_url
inputs.about: The default URL to redirect customers to when they click on the portal's link to return to your website.

inputs.name: on_behalf_of
inputs.about: The account for which the session is being created. Used for filtering subscriptions and invoices.

inputs.name: configuration
inputs.about: The ID of an existing portal configuration. If not specified, the default configuration is used.

inputs.name: customer_account
inputs.about: The ID of an existing account. One of 'customer' or 'customer_account' is required.

tools.name: Create charge (deprecated)
tools.description: Tool to create a charge to request payment from a credit or debit card. Use when you need to charge a payment source directly. Note: This method is deprecated; Stripe recommends using the Payment Intents API instead for new integrations.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.about: A positive integer representing how much to charge in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents for $1.00). Minimum $0.50 USD equivalent; supports up to eight digits.

inputs.name: source
inputs.about: Payment source to charge (card ID, bank account, source, token, or connected account). Customer ID required for certain source types.

inputs.name: capture
inputs.about: Whether to immediately capture charge (defaults to true). When false, authorizes charge for later capture; uncaptured charges expire after set period.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.about: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase. Must be a supported currency.

inputs.name: customer
inputs.about: ID of existing customer to charge. Maximum 500 characters.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Key-value pairs for storing additional structured information about the object. Individual or all keys can be unset.

inputs.name: shipping
inputs.about: Shipping information for the charge.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: An arbitrary string which you can attach to a Charge object. Displayed in web interface and included in automatic receipt emails.

inputs.name: on_behalf_of
inputs.about: Stripe account ID for funds destination; specifies business of record as connected account.

inputs.name: radar_options
inputs.about: Options to configure Radar fraud detection.

inputs.name: receipt_email
inputs.about: Email address for charge receipt delivery. Maximum 800 characters. Overrides customer email if specified.

inputs.name: transfer_data
inputs.about: Dictionary for automatic account transfer as destination charge.

inputs.name: transfer_group
inputs.about: String identifying transaction as part of a group for grouping transactions.

inputs.name: statement_descriptor
inputs.about: Text on customer statement for non-card charges (22-character limit). Ignored for card charges if suffix specified.

inputs.name: application_fee_amount
inputs.about: Fee in cents applied to charge and transferred to application owner's account. Requires OAuth key or Stripe-Account header.

inputs.name: statement_descriptor_suffix
inputs.about: Information concatenated to account prefix for card charges; forms complete statement descriptor.

tools.name: Create Charge Refund
tools.description: Tool to create a refund for a charge in Stripe. Use when you need to refund a previously created charge fully or partially.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.about: Amount in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents) to refund. If omitted, the entire charge is refunded.

inputs.name: charge
inputs.about: Identifier of the charge to refund.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.about: Reasons for issuing a refund in Stripe.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Set of key-value pairs to attach to the refund for storing additional information.

inputs.name: payment_intent
inputs.about: Identifier of the PaymentIntent to refund.

inputs.name: reverse_transfer
inputs.about: Whether to reverse the transfer. Reversal is proportional to the refund amount.

inputs.name: instructions_email
inputs.about: Email address to send refund instructions for payment methods lacking native refund support.

inputs.name: refund_application_fee
inputs.about: Whether to refund the application fee. Full refunds refund the entire fee; partial refunds refund proportionally.

tools.name: Create Checkout Session
tools.description: Tool to create a Stripe Checkout Session. Use when you need a secure, hosted URL to collect payments or subscriptions via Stripe Checkout.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.about: Session mode. Note: 'setup' mode does not use line_items.

inputs.name: customer
inputs.about: ID of existing Customer to attach or prefill.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Key-value pairs to attach to the session.

inputs.name: cancel_url
inputs.about: URL to redirect customers if they cancel payment.

inputs.name: line_items
inputs.about: List of items the customer is purchasing. Each item must have either 'price' (ID of existing Price) or 'price_data' (inline price). Required for 'payment' and 'subscription' modes, not used in 'setup' mode.

inputs.name: success_url

tools.name: Create a price
tools.description: Creates a new Stripe Price for a product, defining its charges (one-time or recurring) and billing scheme; requires either an existing `product` ID or `product_data`.

inputs.name: tiers
inputs.about: A list of pricing tiers. Required if `billing_scheme` is 'tiered'.

inputs.name: active
inputs.about: Whether the price can be used for new purchases. Defaults to true.

inputs.name: product
inputs.about: The ID of the product this price is for. Required if `product_data` is not provided.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.about: Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., 'usd', 'eur'). Must be a supported currency.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: A set of key-value pairs to store additional information about the price.

inputs.name: nickname
inputs.about: A brief, internal-facing description of the price. Useful for distinguishing prices in listings.

inputs.name: recurring
inputs.about: Specifies recurring components of a price, such as billing interval and usage type.

inputs.name: lookup_key
inputs.about: A unique, user-defined key to retrieve this price. Case-sensitive.

inputs.name: tiers_mode
inputs.about: Defines how the quantity is applied to the tiers. Either 'graduated' (price is sum of costs from applicable tiers) or 'volume' (price is determined by the tier corresponding to the total quantity). Required if `billing_scheme` is 'tiered'.

inputs.name: unit_amount
inputs.about: The base charge amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD). Required if not using `tiers`, `custom_unit_amount`, or `currency_options` with a unit amount for the primary currency.

inputs.name: product_data
inputs.about: Fields for creating a new product if a `product` ID is not provided with the price.

inputs.name: tax_behavior
inputs.about: Specifies how tax is applied to the price. Options are 'inclusive' (tax is included), 'exclusive' (tax is added), or 'unspecified'.

inputs.name: billing_scheme
inputs.about: Describes how to compute the price per period. Either 'per_unit' (default, for fixed price per unit) or 'tiered' (for volume-based or graduated tiers).

inputs.name: currency_options
inputs.about: Prices defined in each supported currency. Useful for multi-currency pricing. The primary `currency`'s pricing can also be defined here.

inputs.name: custom_unit_amount
inputs.about: Configuration for a price where the unit amount is set by the customer at checkout.

inputs.name: transform_quantity
inputs.about: Contains information about how the quantity should be transformed before calculating the price.

inputs.name: transfer_lookup_key
inputs.about: If `true`, allows this price to overwrite an existing price with the same `lookup_key`. Defaults to `false`.

inputs.name: unit_amount_decimal
inputs.about: Same as `unit_amount`, but accepts a decimal string with up to 12 decimal places for higher precision. Required if not using `tiers`, `custom_unit_amount`, or `currency_options` with a unit amount for the primary currency and `unit_amount` is not provided.

inputs.name: discounts

inputs.name: description

inputs.name: off_session

inputs.name: on_behalf_of

inputs.name: automatic_tax

inputs.name: transfer_data

inputs.name: days_until_due

inputs.name: default_source

inputs.name: promotion_code

inputs.name: trial_settings

inputs.name: trial_from_plan
inputs.about: Inherit trial period from the plan of the first item.

inputs.name: invoice_settings

inputs.name: payment_behavior
inputs.about: Behavior when initial payment fails or requires SCA (e.g., 3D Secure authentication). Options: 'allow_incomplete' (default) - creates subscription with status='incomplete' if the first invoice can't be paid; 'default_incomplete' - creates subscription with status='incomplete' when payment is require

inputs.name: payment_settings

inputs.name: add_invoice_items

inputs.name: collection_method

'send_invoice' emails an invoice with payment instructions - subscriptions using this method activate regardless of first invoice status and don't require a payment method.

inputs.name: default_tax_rates

inputs.name: trial_period_days
inputs.about: Number of days for the trial period. During the trial, no payment is required - this allows creating subscriptions without a payment method attached. Payment will be collected when the trial ends.

inputs.name: billing_thresholds
inputs.about: Subscription-level billing thresholds for metered billing.

inputs.name: proration_behavior
inputs.about: How to handle prorations on subscription changes.

inputs.name: backdate_start_date
inputs.about: Unix timestamp to backdate the subscription's start.

inputs.name: billing_cycle_anchor
inputs.about: Unix timestamp to anchor the subscription's billing cycle.

inputs.name: cancel_at_period_end
inputs.about: Cancel the subscription at the end of the current billing period.

inputs.name: default_payment_method
inputs.about: ID of the default payment method for this subscription (must be attached to customer). Not required if: (1) using trial_period_days or trial_end for trial subscriptions, or (2) using collection_method='send_invoice' for invoice-based billing.

inputs.name: application_fee_percent
inputs.about: Percentage (0-100) of subscription amount as an application fee for the platform.

inputs.name: billing_cycle_anchor_config
inputs.about: Configure the billing cycle anchor using a specific day, hour, minute, etc.

inputs.name: pending_invoice_item_interval
inputs.about: Configuration for generating pending invoice items for usage-based billing.

tools.name: Create subscription item
tools.description: Tool to add a new item to an existing subscription without changing existing items. Use when adding a product or service to a customer's subscription.

inputs.name: price

inputs.name: metadata

inputs.name: quantity

inputs.name: discounts

inputs.name: tax_rates

inputs.name: price_data

inputs.name: subscription

inputs.name: proration_date

inputs.name: payment_behavior
inputs.about: Payment behavior options for handling incomplete payments.

inputs.name: billing_thresholds

inputs.name: proration_behavior
inputs.about: Determines how to handle prorations. Default is create_prorations.

tools.name: Create subscription schedule

inputs.name: phases

inputs.name: customer
inputs.about: Customer identifier for the schedule

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Custom key-value data

inputs.name: start_date

inputs.name: billing_mode
inputs.about: Controls prorations and invoice calculation.

inputs.name: end_behavior
inputs.about: End behavior. Values: 'release' (continue subscription) or 'cancel' (terminate)

inputs.name: customer_account
inputs.about: Account identifier for the schedule

inputs.name: default_settings
inputs.about: Schedule-wide defaults.

inputs.name: from_subscription
inputs.about: Migrate existing subscription to schedule

tools.name: Create Tax Calculation
tools.description: Creates a Tax Calculation to compute taxes for customer purchases. Use when you need to calculate taxes for a transaction before finalizing it, such as displaying tax amounts in a shopping cart.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.about: Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase. Must be a supported currency. All amounts in the calculation must use this currency.

inputs.name: customer
inputs.about: ID of an existing Stripe Customer. If provided, the customer's address and tax IDs will be used. Cannot be used together with 'customer_details'.

inputs.name: tax_date
inputs.about: Unix timestamp specifying the date for which tax rules and rates should apply. Defaults to the current date if not provided.

inputs.name: line_items
inputs.about: List of line items the customer is purchasing. At least one line item is required. Each line item must have a unique 'reference'.

inputs.name: shipping_cost
inputs.about: Shipping cost for tax calculation.

inputs.name: customer_details
inputs.about: Extended customer details including tax IDs.

inputs.name: ship_from_details
inputs.about: Shipping origin details.

tools.name: Create Tax ID
tools.description: Creates a new tax ID for an account or customer. Use when you need to add tax identification for compliance and invoicing purposes.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Type of the tax ID. Supports 100+ types including: ad_nrt, ae_trn, al_tin, am_tin, ao_tin, ar_cuit, au_abn, au_arn, aw_tin, az_tin, ba_tin, bb_tin, bd_bin, bf_ifu, bg_uic, bh_vat, bj_ifu, bo_tin, br_cnpj, br_cpf, bs_tin, by_tin, ca_bn, ca_gst_hst, ca_pst_bc, ca_pst_mb, ca_pst_sk, ca_qst, cd_nif, ch_

inputs.name: owner
inputs.about: Owner information for the tax ID.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The value of the tax ID.

tools.name: Create tax rate
tools.description: Tool to create a new tax rate in Stripe. Use when you need to define a tax rate for invoices, subscriptions, or checkout sessions.

inputs.name: state
inputs.about: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code without country prefix (e.g., 'NY' for New York).

inputs.name: active
inputs.about: Whether the tax rate is active. Inactive rates cannot be used with new applications but continue to work for existing subscriptions. Defaults to true.

inputs.name: country
inputs.about: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US', 'CA').

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured information.

inputs.name: tax_type
inputs.about: The type of tax. One of: amusement_tax, communications_tax, gst, hst, igst, jct, lease_tax, pst, qst, retail_delivery_fee, rst, sales_tax, service_tax, or vat.

inputs.name: inclusive
inputs.about: Whether the tax is included in the price (true) or added on top (false).

inputs.name: percentage
inputs.about: The tax percentage value (e.g., 8.5 for 8.5%). This value is out of 100.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: An arbitrary string for internal use only. Not displayed to customers.

inputs.name: display_name
inputs.about: The display name of the tax rate shown to users. Maximum 50 characters.

inputs.name: jurisdiction
inputs.about: The jurisdiction for the tax rate. Maximum 50 characters. Displayed on customer invoices for reporting purposes.

tools.name: Create Tax Registration
tools.description: Creates a new Tax Registration object to enable tax collection in specified jurisdictions. Use when setting up tax collection for a new country, state, or province.

inputs.name: country
inputs.about: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where tax collection will be enabled (e.g., 'US', 'CA', 'GB', 'DE').

inputs.name: expires_at
inputs.about: Optional Unix timestamp in seconds when the registration becomes inactive. Omit for indefinite validity.

inputs.name: active_from
inputs.about: Activation time for the registration. Use 'now' for immediate activation or provide a future Unix timestamp in seconds for scheduled activation.

inputs.name: country_options
inputs.about: Country-specific configuration object. The key must match the country code. Value contains type-specific configuration (e.g., for US: includes 'state' and 'type'; for EU: includes 'type' and 'standard' config when type='standard'; for CA: includes 'type' and optional nested configs).

tools.name: Create Tax Transaction from Calculation
tools.description: Tool to create a Tax Transaction from a calculation before 90-day expiration. Use when you need to finalize tax calculations and create a permanent transaction record.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Key-value pairs for storing additional information. Individual or all keys can be cleared by posting empty values.

inputs.name: posted_at
inputs.about: Unix timestamp when tax liability is assumed/reduced. Must be between tax_date and current time. Defaults to current time if not specified.

inputs.name: reference
inputs.about: Custom order/sale identifier (e.g., 'myOrder_123'). Must be unique across all transactions and reversals. Maximum length: 500 characters.

inputs.name: calculation
inputs.about: The ID of the Tax Calculation to use as input. Must be a valid, non-expired calculation (expires after 90 days).

tools.name: Create Terminal Configuration
tools.description: Creates a new Configuration object for Stripe payment terminals with customizable settings. Use when setting up terminal readers with specific device configurations, offline settings, tipping options, or WiFi credentials.

inputs.name: name

inputs.name: wifi

inputs.about: Device-specific settings for terminal readers.

inputs.name: reader_security

tools.description: Creates a short-lived connection token for Stripe Terminal SDK to connect to readers. Use when initializing a Terminal connection with the Stripe Terminal SDK.

inputs.name: location
inputs.about: The id of the location that this connection token is scoped to. If specified the connection token will only be usable with readers assigned to that location, otherwise the connection token will be usable with all readers. Note that location scoping only applies to internet-connected readers.

tools.name: Create Terminal Location

inputs.name: metadata

inputs.name: display_name

inputs.name: configuration_overrides
inputs.about: The ID of a configuration that will be used to customize all readers at this location. Maximum 500 characters.

tools.name: Create Terminal Onboarding Link
tools.description: Creates an onboarding link for Tap to Pay on iPhone. Use when you need to generate a redirect URL for merchants to complete the Apple Terms and Conditions acceptance flow. The generated link directs merchants through the required onboarding process.

inputs.name: expand

inputs.name: link_options

inputs.name: on_behalf_of

tools.name: Create Test Clock
tools.description: Tool to create a test clock for testing time-based scenarios in Stripe. Use when you need to simulate the passage of time for testing subscriptions, trials, or other time-dependent features.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name for this test clock. Maximum length is 300 characters.

inputs.name: frozen_time
inputs.about: The initial frozen time for this test clock. Unix timestamp representing the starting point in time.

tools.name: Create Test Confirmation Token (Test Mode Only)
tools.description: Creates a test mode Confirmation Token for server-side payment integration testing. Confirmation Tokens securely transport payment method details collected client-side to your server for confirming PaymentIntents or SetupIntents. This test helper allows you to create these tokens server-side for testing without using Stripe.js. IMPORTANT: This endpoint requires TEST MODE API keys (sk_test_...). inputs.name: shipping

inputs.name: return_url
inputs.about: URL to redirect customer after authenticating the payment (required for some payment methods).

inputs.name: payment_method
inputs.about: ID of an existing PaymentMethod to attach (e.g., 'pm_1ABC...'). Provide either this OR payment_method_data, not both.

inputs.name: setup_future_usage
inputs.about: Indicates how the payment method should be saved for future use. 'off_session' = save for future automatic charges, 'on_session' = save for future customer-initiated charges.

inputs.name: payment_method_data

inputs.name: payment_method_options

tools.name: Create CVC update token

inputs.name: cvc_update
inputs.about: Container object for the updated CVC information.

tools.name: Create Transfer
tools.description: Creates a transfer to move funds between Stripe accounts as part of Connect. Use when you need to move money from your platform's balance to a connected Stripe account, such as paying out to sellers or distributing funds to connected accounts.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.about: A positive integer in cents (or local equivalent) representing how much to transfer.

inputs.name: expand
inputs.about: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.about: Three-letter ISO code for currency in lowercase. Must be a supported currency.

inputs.name: metadata

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users.

inputs.name: destination
inputs.about: The ID of a connected Stripe account. See the Connect documentation for details.

inputs.name: source_type
inputs.about: The source balance to use for this transfer.

inputs.name: transfer_group

inputs.name: source_transaction
inputs.about: You can use this parameter to transfer funds from a charge before they are added to your available balance.

tools.name: Create usage record
tools.description: Creates a legacy usage record for a specified subscription item and timestamp. The legacy UsageRecords API requires a pre-Basil Stripe API version; availability depends on the account's API version.

inputs.name: action
inputs.about: How to handle the usage value. 'increment' (default) adds to the sum (assumes aggregate_usage=sum). 'set' overwrites the value for aggregation modes using last_during_period or last_ever.

inputs.name: quantity
inputs.about: The usage quantity for the specified timestamp. Must be a positive integer.

inputs.name: timestamp
inputs.about: Unix timestamp (in seconds) indicating when the usage occurred. Must fall within the current billing period, or the call will fail. A short grace period exists at billing period boundaries to account for clock drift.

inputs.name: subscription_item
inputs.about: The ID of the subscription item for which to create the usage record.

tools.name: Deactivate billing alert
tools.description: Tool to deactivate a billing alert, preventing it from triggering. Use when you need to stop a billing alert from monitoring usage thresholds.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the billing alert to deactivate. Must start with 'alrt_'.

tools.name: Deactivate Billing Meter
tools.description: Deactivates a billing meter. Use when you need to stop a meter from accepting new events and prevent it from being attached to prices.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the billing meter to deactivate.

tools.name: Delete Apple Pay Domain
tools.description: Tool to delete an Apple Pay domain from a Stripe account. Use when you need to remove a previously registered Apple Pay domain. This operation is permanent and cannot be undone.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.about: The identifier of the Apple Pay domain to delete. This ID typically starts with 'apwc_'. Maximum length: 5000 characters.

tools.name: Delete apps secret
tools.description: Tool to delete a secret from the Stripe Secret Store by name and scope. Use when you need to permanently remove a secret. Requests from UI extensions can only access account-scoped secrets or secrets scoped to their own user.

inputs.name: name

inputs.name: scope_type
inputs.about: The scope type - either 'account' (accessible to all UI contexts within the account) or 'user' (per-user secrets). Required parameter.

inputs.name: scope_user
inputs.about: User ID - required when scope_type is 'user', omitted for 'account' type. The user whose secret to delete.

tools.name: Delete coupon
tools.description: Tool to delete a coupon from Stripe. Use when you need to remove a coupon code, preventing new redemptions while preserving existing customer discounts.

inputs.name: coupon
inputs.about: The identifier of the coupon to be deleted. Deleting a coupon removes it from the Stripe system, preventing new customers from redeeming it. Customers who have already applied the coupon retain their discount.

tools.name: Delete customer (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use STRIPE_DELETE_CUSTOMERS_CUSTOMER instead. Permanently deletes an existing Stripe customer; this irreversible action also cancels their active subscriptions and removes all associated data.

inputs.name: customer_id

tools.name: Delete customer bank account

inputs.name: customer

tools.name: Delete customer discount

inputs.name: customer

inputs.name: customer
inputs.about: The identifier of the customer to be deleted. Must be a valid Stripe customer ID starting with 'cus_'.

tools.name: Cancel customer subscription

tools.name: Delete customer subscription discount
tools.description: Removes currently applied discount from a customer's subscription. Use when you need to remove a discount code or promotion from a specific subscription belonging to a customer.

inputs.name: customer
inputs.about: The ID of the customer. Must start with 'cus_' followed by alphanumeric characters.

inputs.name: subscription_exposed_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the subscription from which to remove the discount. This is the subscription ID starting with 'sub_'.

tools.name: Delete customer tax ID
tools.description: Deletes a customer's tax ID object. Use when you need to remove a specific tax identification from a customer's account.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID of the tax ID object to delete. Must start with 'txi_' followed by alphanumeric characters.

inputs.name: customer
inputs.about: The ID of the customer whose tax ID will be deleted. Must start with 'cus_' followed by alphanumeric characters.

tools.name: Delete ephemeral key

inputs.name: key

tools.name: Delete draft invoice

inputs.name: invoice

tools.name: Delete invoice item

tools.name: Delete plan

inputs.name: plan
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the plan to be deleted.

tools.name: Delete product

tools.name: Delete product feature

inputs.name: product

inputs.about: The ID of the subscription from which to remove the discount. Must start with 'sub_' followed by alphanumeric characters.

tools.name: Delete subscription item

tools.name: Delete tax ID

inputs.name: configuration

tools.name: Delete Terminal Location
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Terminal Location object from your Stripe account. Use when you need to remove a physical location where Terminal readers are no longer deployed. This operation is permanent and irreversible.

inputs.name: location
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Terminal Location to delete. Must start with 'tml_' followed by alphanumeric characters.

tools.name: Delete Terminal Reader

inputs.name: reader

tools.name: Delete test clock

inputs.name: test_clock

tools.name: Void an invoice

inputs.name: payment_method_types
inputs.about: List of accepted payment method types.

inputs.name: allow_promotion_codes
inputs.about: Whether the payment link accepts promotion codes.

inputs.name: phone_number_collection
inputs.about: Configuration for phone number collection.

inputs.name: payment_method_collection
inputs.about: Payment method collection approach: 'always' or 'if_required'.

inputs.name: billing_address_collection
inputs.about: Billing address collection approach: 'auto' or 'required'.

inputs.name: shipping_address_collection
inputs.about: Configuration for shipping address collection.

tools.name: Update Payment Method
tools.description: Updates an existing PaymentMethod object in Stripe. Use when you need to modify billing details, expiration dates, or metadata for a payment method. The payment method must be attached to a customer before updates can be applied.

inputs.name: card
inputs.about: Card details for card-type payment methods.

inputs.name: payto
inputs.about: PayTo payment method details.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Key-value pairs for storing additional structured data. Post an empty object to clear all metadata.

inputs.name: allow_redisplay
inputs.about: Controls whether the payment method displays in checkout flows. Options: always, limited, unspecified.

inputs.name: billing_details
inputs.about: Billing information associated with the PaymentMethod.

inputs.name: us_bank_account
inputs.about: US bank account details.

inputs.name: payment_method_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the payment method to update. Must be attached to a customer.

tools.name: Update a price
tools.description: Updates a Stripe price by setting passed parameter values; unspecified parameters remain unchanged. Use when you need to modify price metadata, active status, lookup key, or nickname. Note: Price amounts cannot be modified via API.

inputs.name: price
inputs.about: The ID of the price to update.

inputs.name: active
inputs.about: Whether the price can be used for new purchases. Defaults to true.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Key-value pairs for storing additional information. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.

inputs.name: nickname
inputs.about: Internal price description (hidden from customers).

inputs.name: lookup_key
inputs.about: Retrieval identifier (max 200 characters).

inputs.name: tax_behavior
inputs.about: Tax classification: 'inclusive', 'exclusive', or 'unspecified'. Once specified, it cannot be changed.

inputs.name: currency_options
inputs.about: Per-currency pricing configuration. Keys must be ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes.

inputs.name: transfer_lookup_key
inputs.about: When true, atomically moves lookup key from another price to this one.

tools.name: Update product
tools.description: Tool to update an existing product in Stripe. Use when you need to modify product details like name, description, pricing, or availability.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the product to update.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: A URL of a publicly-accessible webpage for this product.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The product's name, meant to be displayable to the customer.

inputs.name: active
inputs.about: Whether the product is available for purchase. Set to false to archive.

inputs.name: images
inputs.about: A list of up to 8 URLs of images for this product, meant to be displayable to the customer.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.

inputs.name: tax_code
inputs.about: A tax code ID for determining tax rates on sales of this product.

inputs.name: shippable
inputs.about: Whether this product is shipped (i.e., physical goods).

inputs.name: unit_label
inputs.about: A label that represents units of this product. When set, this will be included in customers' receipts, invoices, Checkout, and the customer portal. Use singular form. Up to 12 characters.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: The product's description, meant to be displayable to the customer. Use this field to optionally store a long form explanation of the product being sold for your own rendering purposes.

inputs.name: default_price
inputs.about: The ID of the Price object that is the default price for this product.

inputs.name: marketing_features
inputs.about: A list of up to 15 marketing features for this product. These are displayed in pricing tables.

inputs.name: package_dimensions
inputs.about: The dimensions of the product for shipping purposes.

inputs.name: statement_descriptor
inputs.about: An arbitrary string to be displayed on your customer's credit card or bank statement. While most banks display this information consistently, some may display it incorrectly or not at all. This may be up to 22 characters.

tools.name: Update Promotion Code
tools.description: Updates an existing Stripe promotion code by setting the values of the parameters passed. Use when you need to activate/deactivate a promotion code, update its metadata, or modify redemption restrictions. Most promotion code fields are intentionally non-editable after creation.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID of the promotion code to update.

inputs.name: active
inputs.about: Whether the promotion code is currently active. Set to true to reactivate (requires a valid coupon and redeemable status), or false to deactivate.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured information. Keys can be up to 40 characters, values up to 500 characters. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value.

inputs.name: restrictions
inputs.about: Settings controlling promotion code redemption conditions.

tools.name: Update Quote
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Stripe quote with new values. Use when modifying quote details like description, line items, metadata, or other quote parameters.

inputs.name: quote
inputs.about: The ID of the quote to update.

inputs.name: footer
inputs.about: Quote PDF footer text (max 500 characters).

inputs.name: header
inputs.about: Quote PDF header text (max 50 characters).

inputs.name: customer
inputs.about: Customer ID. Required before finalizing; cannot be changed once set.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Custom key-value pairs for structured data storage.

inputs.name: discounts
inputs.about: Applied discounts using coupon, discount ID, or promotion code.

inputs.name: expires_at
inputs.about: Future Unix timestamp when draft/open quote auto-cancels.

inputs.name: line_items
inputs.about: Quoted products and services with quantities and costs.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Quote PDF description (max 500 characters).

inputs.name: on_behalf_of
inputs.about: Account to charge on behalf of.

inputs.name: automatic_tax
inputs.about: Automatic tax computation settings.

inputs.name: transfer_data
inputs.about: Automatic transfer configuration per invoice.

inputs.name: customer_account
inputs.about: Account ID. Required before finalizing; immutable after setting.

inputs.name: invoice_settings
inputs.about: Invoice billing configuration.

inputs.name: collection_method
inputs.about: Payment method: 'charge_automatically' or 'send_invoice'. Defaults to automatic.

inputs.name: default_tax_rates
inputs.about: Tax rates applied to line items without specific rates.

inputs.name: subscription_data
inputs.about: Subscription/schedule configuration data.

inputs.name: application_fee_amount
inputs.about: Fee amount transferred to application owner's Stripe account. Cannot be used with recurring line items.

inputs.name: application_fee_percent
inputs.about: Percentage (0-100, max 2 decimals) of subscription invoice transferred to app owner. Requires at least one recurring line item.

tools.name: Update Source
tools.description: Updates a Stripe source with specified parameters. Use when you need to modify source metadata, owner information, or mandate details. NOTE: The Stripe Sources API is deprecated. Stripe recommends migrating to the Payment Methods API for new integrations. This action only works with sources created before the API deprecation.

inputs.name: owner
inputs.about: Payment instrument holder information.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.about: Monetary value linked to the source.

inputs.name: source
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the source object to be updated.

inputs.name: mandate
inputs.about: Bank debit authorization details.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Set of key-value pairs for storing additional information.

inputs.name: source_order
inputs.about: Items and shipping details for transactional sources.

tools.name: Update Subscription
tools.description: Updates an existing, non-canceled Stripe subscription by its ID, including supported item, billing, payment, tax, cancellation, and metadata settings.

inputs.name: items
inputs.about: List of subscription item updates (max 20). Item `id` usually required for modification.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Key-value pairs for custom information (max 50 keys: 40 chars; values: 500 chars). Replaces existing; empty dict removes all.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Arbitrary string for user display or internal tracking.

inputs.name: automatic_tax
inputs.about: Stripe Tax settings for automatic tax calculation. `liability` may be required if `enabled` is true.

inputs.name: subscription_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the subscription to update.

inputs.name: payment_behavior
inputs.about: Payment handling for invoices.

inputs.name: collection_method
inputs.about: How invoices are paid.

inputs.name: proration_behavior
inputs.about: How to handle prorations on changes.

inputs.name: billing_cycle_anchor
inputs.about: Unix timestamp (seconds) or 'now' to anchor billing cycle and renewal. Changes may cause proration.

inputs.name: cancel_at_period_end
inputs.about: If true, schedules cancellation at current period's end; if false, undoes scheduled cancellation.

inputs.name: default_payment_method
inputs.about: ID of the default payment method; updates subscription's default payment source if provided.

tools.name: Update Subscription Schedule
tools.description: Tool to update an existing subscription schedule in Stripe. Use when you need to modify phases, default settings, metadata, or end behavior of a subscription schedule.

inputs.name: phases
inputs.about: List of subscription phases with distinct configurations.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Custom key-value pairs for storing additional information.

inputs.name: schedule
inputs.about: The ID of the subscription schedule to update.

inputs.name: end_behavior
inputs.about: How to handle underlying subscription when schedule ends: 'release' (default) or 'cancel'.

inputs.name: default_settings
inputs.about: Default settings for subscription schedule.

inputs.name: proration_behavior
inputs.about: How to handle prorations for billing configuration changes: 'create_prorations' (default), 'always_invoice', or 'none'.

tools.name: Update Tax Registration
tools.description: Tool to update an existing tax registration in Stripe. Use when you need to modify the active_from or expires_at fields of a registration. Registrations cannot be deleted after creation; use expires_at to terminate them instead.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the tax registration object to update.

inputs.name: expires_at
inputs.about: Time at which the registration expires. Can be 'now' or a Unix timestamp in seconds. If not set, the registration will remain active indefinitely.

inputs.name: active_from
inputs.about: Time at which the registration becomes active. Can be 'now' or a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: Update Tax Settings
tools.description: Updates Stripe Tax Settings parameters used in tax calculations. Use to configure default tax behavior, tax codes, and business head office location for tax purposes.

inputs.name: defaults
inputs.about: Default tax configuration settings.

inputs.name: head_office
inputs.about: The place where your business is located for tax purposes.

tools.name: Update Terminal Location
tools.description: Updates a Terminal Location by modifying specified parameters. Use when you need to change location details like display name, address, phone, or metadata.

inputs.name: phone
inputs.about: The phone number of the location.

inputs.name: address
inputs.about: The full address of the location.

inputs.name: location
inputs.about: The identifier of the location to update. Must start with 'tml_' followed by alphanumeric characters.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Set of key-value pairs for storing additional information. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.

inputs.name: address_kana
inputs.about: Kana variation of the address (Japan only).

inputs.name: display_name
inputs.about: A name for the location.

inputs.name: address_kanji
inputs.about: Kanji variation of the address (Japan only).

inputs.name: display_name_kana
inputs.about: Kana variation of the display name (Japan only).

inputs.name: display_name_kanji
inputs.about: Kanji variation of the display name (Japan only).

inputs.name: configuration_overrides
inputs.about: Configuration ID to be used to customize all readers at this location.

tools.name: Update Terminal Reader
tools.description: Tool to update a Terminal Reader object by setting parameter values. Use when you need to modify the label or metadata of an existing reader device.

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: Custom label name for the reader to help distinguish it from other readers. Use this to set a friendly name.

inputs.name: reader
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Terminal Reader to update. Must start with 'tmr_' followed by alphanumeric characters.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.

tools.name: Validate payment method domain
tools.description: Tool to validate an existing payment method domain in Stripe to activate payment methods. Use when additional registration steps need to be completed before a payment method can be used in Elements or Embedded Checkout.

inputs.name: payment_method_domain
inputs.about: The payment method domain identifier to validate (e.g., pmd_1Nnrer2eZvKYlo2Cips79tWl).

tools.name: Verify microdeposits on setup intent
tools.description: Verifies microdeposits on a SetupIntent object to confirm bank account ownership. Use when customer needs to verify their bank account using either amounts or descriptor code from microdeposits.

inputs.name: amounts
inputs.about: Two positive integers, in cents, equal to the values of the microdeposits sent to the bank account. Provide this OR descriptor_code.

inputs.name: descriptor_code
inputs.about: A six-character code starting with SM present in the microdeposit sent to the bank account. Provide this OR amounts.

inputs.name: setup_intent_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the SetupIntent to verify microdeposits for.

tools.name: Verify microdeposits on payment intent
tools.description: Verifies microdeposits on a PaymentIntent object by matching deposit amounts or descriptor code. Use after microdeposits are sent to complete bank account verification.

inputs.name: intent
inputs.about: The ID of the PaymentIntent to verify microdeposits for.

inputs.name: amounts
inputs.about: Two positive integers, in cents, equal to the values of the microdeposits sent to the bank account. Used to verify account ownership by matching the deposit amounts. Either amounts or descriptor_code must be provided, but not both.

inputs.name: descriptor_code
inputs.about: A six-character code starting with SM present in the microdeposit sent to the bank account. This is an alternative verification method to using amounts. Either amounts or descriptor_code must be provided, but not both.

tools.name: Void a credit note
tools.description: Marks a credit note as void. Use when you need to void a credit note and reverse its adjustments.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The identifier of the credit note to void. Typically starts with 'cn_'.

tools.name: Void an invoice
tools.description: Voids a finalized Stripe invoice while maintaining a paper trail. Voiding is permanent and cannot be undone; draft invoices should be deleted instead.

inputs.name: invoice_id
inputs.about: The identifier of the invoice to void. Must be a finalized invoice. Draft invoices should be deleted instead of voided.

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Return the connected Stripe account (account id, dashboard name). Identity is account-level.
